title.narrative: Emergency Relief Support Project in Ilam

description.narrative: In October 2025, Ilam district was hit by floods and landslides, causing 37 deaths, 1 missing, and widespread destruction of homes, infrastructure, and livelihoods across eight municipalities. Thousands were displaced, lacking shelter, food, health, and sanitation, while agriculture and food stocks were destroyed, increasing food insecurity and disease risk. This project targets 350 vulnerable households, including women, Dalits, and Indigenous groups, providing emergency food, shelter items, warm clothing, and hygiene kits, with post-distribution monitoring and community engagement to ensure timely relief and accountability.

Specific Objectives:1. Distribute emergency food supplies (rice, dal, salt, oil, sugar).2. Provide essential non-food items (mattresses, tarpaulins, blankets, warm clothing).3. Distribute hygiene and dignity kits (soap, sanitary pads, toothbrush/paste, towels).4. Conduct post-distribution monitoring and community engagement to ensure accountability.
The project targets approximately 350 of the most vulnerable households in the hardest-hit municipalities, with a focus on women, Dalits, Indigenous peoples, and other marginalized groups.
